I can do that, but a few details are ambiguous. Please confirm each item below (you can answer with short replies):

1) Recipient — what exact address or group alias should I forward to? (e.g., finance@company.com).  
2) Attachments — include all thread attachments or omit them?  
3) Message — add an introductory note? If yes, paste the text you want included (or say “No note”).  
4) Action — send immediately or create a draft for your review first? (I recommend a draft.)

If you prefer, reply with one-line instructions like:
- “Forward to finance@company.com, include attachments, add note ‘Please review’, send now”
or
- “Create draft to finance-group alias, omit attachments, no note”

I won’t send anything until you confirm.
